decision.thesis: Account flat, no position, nothing to reconcile. Best candidate was again ETHUSDT, and BOTH directions are refused. THE HEADLINE: THE 20:00 NOTE PREDICTED THIS CHECK'S TRAP IN WRITING AND THE PREDICTION IS CONFIRMED TO THREE DECIMAL PLACES. It wrote that the 09:30Z bar (0.551% range) would leave the twelve-bar window and N would 'collapse toward ~0.20%, mechanically making the same stops look acceptable on the same structure'. Measured now: N(hour) = 0.205%, and the 09:30Z bar has ALSO left the 2h window (N(2h) = 0.205%, the same 12:00Z bar). NOTHING HAPPENED EXCEPT SIXTY MINUTES. Per L-002's amendment and L-006 the binding window is the one containing the bar that created the level being traded - the 09:30Z-10:30Z leg built the 2633.31 24h low that every short targets - so the binding N is 0.551% and the required span is 1.5175%. SECOND HEADLINE: THE EVIDENCE GATE, WHICH PASSED FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER AT 20:00, HAS FAILED AGAIN AT 21:00 - AND IT FAILED BECAUSE THE MARKET MOVED, NOT BECAUSE OF ARITHMETIC. `price_action` has FLIPPED FROM SUPPORTING THE SHORT TO OPPOSING IT: the 2650.63/2650.17 level that was 'rejected seven times' at 20:00 has been BROKEN (12:25Z printed 2651.66, then 2656.03 by 13:16Z) and a HIGHER LOW formed at 2640.00. The failed bounce has failed to fail. For a SHORT only `trend` survives - ONE category, GATE FAILS. For a LONG the breakout is twenty minutes old and the strategy is explicit that 'a breakout at 21:00 that has not held is not evidence yet' - GATE FAILS. The 20:00 note flagged this exact hazard in advance (its point 3). L-005 REFUSES EVERY CONTRACT INDEPENDENTLY OF ALL GEOMETRY, a 13th consecutive check, and produces a form worse than 20:00's: ETHUSDT's BID - the side a short sells into, a long exits into, and where a long's reduce-only stop rests between checks - read 148.73 USDT and then 39.84 USDT ON TWO CONSECUTIVE SAMPLES (20:00 had two collapses but with full recoveries between). A maximum 2,500 USDT market sell is 17x and 63x the entire visible bid. BTCUSDT's ASK went 2,394.14 then 627.92 USDT on two consecutive samples while its bid was 502.10 at s1 - unquoted on BOTH sides, one check after being recorded as holding 'the best book of the five'; reputation again lasted less than one check. SOLUSDT lost both sides at once at s5 (bid 85.68, ask 23.99). BNBUSDT's bid pinned at 5,009.07 / 5,009.46 / 5,010.76 across three consecutive samples - static to the dollar, itself an artifact-like print, and only 2x the maximum order notional. NO CONTRACT BREACHED THE 25 bps CAP; the widest spread of the entire check was 9.438 bps and the 39.84 USDT ETH bid quoted 1.017 bps. THE CAP WAS BLIND TO ALL OF IT, A 13TH CONSECUTIVE CHECK. L-003 PRODUCED THE STRONGEST PATHOLOGICAL INSTANCE OF THE EXPERIMENT, SURPASSING 20:00's: the SHORT stop 2657.00 -> target 2633.31 ran net RR 1.110 -> 16.070 -> 16.993 -> 14.978 -> 11.969 across 686 seconds, A 15.3x INFLATION ACROSS THE 1.5 FLOOR, and every bit of it came from the bid drifting 2647.53 -> 2655.89 TOWARD A FIXED STOP: risk collapsed 0.358% -> 0.042% while reward grew 0.537% -> 0.850%, BOTH HALVES IMPROVING FROM ONE CAUSE. At that same instant the stop fell 1.74x -> 0.20x N(hour) and 0.65x -> 0.08x N(honest): 1/12th of a single noise bar. IT CROSSED THE FLOOR AT THE EXACT MOMENT IT STOPPED BEING A STOP AND AT THE EXACT MOMENT THE PREMISE BROKE. AND THE LEGITIMATE FORM FIRED ON THE LONG WITH REAL CONSEQUENCE: LONG 2639.50 -> 2670.98 PAID 1.637 AT THE FIRST QUOTE, CLEARING THE 1.5 FLOOR, AND DECAYED TO 0.683 BY THE SECOND. A SINGLE-QUOTE CHECK WOULD HAVE ENTERED THIS TRADE. That is the clearest demonstration of L-003's purpose the experiment has produced and the clock stays at ZERO, a 14th consecutive material check. L-004 RUN FIRST REFUSES ALL TEN CONSTRUCTIONS ON SPAN against the honest 1.5175% requirement; the closest is LONG 2632.80 -> 2670.98 at 1.441%, FAILING BY 0.077pp, and it is independently killed on target validity because 2670.98 was touched ONCE and is reached only by jumping 2655.01 (4 touches), 2660.99 (4) and 2661.41 (3). Every construction that 'passes' does so ONLY against the hour or 3h windows that have just rolled past the defining bar - the precise trap L-002's amendment and L-006 forbid. L-002 IS DECISIVE A 13TH CONSECUTIVE CHECK AND THE TWO CONDITIONS VISIBLY MOVE IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS, WHICH IS L-004'S CORE CLAIM: the only long stop that is genuinely noise-safe (2632.80, 1.59x N(honest)) pays 0.483-1.001, far below the floor; the long stop that prices better (2639.50) is a MAGNET STOP sitting 0.02-0.06% below a cluster touched 10-11 times (2640.06/2640.00/2640.01 = 11, 2640.48 = 11, 2640.35 = 10, 2640.67 = 10); and every short stop at 2652.00 is now BELOW the market entirely - price rose THROUGH it during the check, making those constructions structurally void. L-001 EXCLUDES FOUR OF FIVE CONTRACTS ON UNREVISED ARTIFACTS: BTCUSDT a 22ND consecutive check (09-21 08:00Z 4h 13.546% upper wick to 95,804.10, 17.29x median range; 09-21 12:00Z 11.709%; 09-21 daily 11.437% on a 6.629% body); SOLUSDT a 12TH (09-22 16:00Z 4h 9.070% lower wick to 106.67, 7.04x median; 09-22 daily 9.941% on a 0.345% body = 28.8x; plus 24h quote volume 462.99M against 103-133 BILLION for the other four, a ~250x shortfall); XRPUSDT (09-23 04:00Z 4h 4.191% wick on a 0.124% body = 33.9x, UNREVISED, plus SIX 1h flags including 130.0x, 51.3x, 27.5x and 20.3x); and BNBUSDT (09-24 00:00Z 4h 1.704% wick on a 0.107% body = 16.0x, UNREVISED and unchanged). RECORDED AGAINST INTEREST AND FOR THE REVIEW: ETHUSDT, the only readable contract, CARRIES THE RECORDED 2850.00 ARTIFACT PRINT IN ITS 09-21 08:00Z 4h BAR (7.221% range = 5.74x the 4h median), and LESSONS L-001 names 2850.00 as an ETH print judged 'since aged out' - a judgement made against the 1h window before the amendment requiring the 4h and daily frames. It flags on range but NOT on wick/body (2.0x), it is 7.5% above the market, and it contaminates no field this check priced against, so ETH is treated as readable here; but WHETHER THE HIGHER-FRAME AMENDMENT RE-CATCHES IT IS THE REVIEW'S CALL, NOT THIS CHECK'S, and if it does then the tradable set is EMPTY. L-006 HAS THREE INSTANCES, THE PRIMARY ONE PREDICTED IN ADVANCE: (1) the N collapse above, predicted verbatim at 20:00 and confirmed at 0.205%; (2) BNBUSDT's DAILY wick/body ratio fell 6.0x -> 1.6x since 20:00 WITHOUT THE 780.90 PRINT BEING REVISED AT ALL - the body grew from 0.245% to 0.666% as price rose, so the DENOMINATOR moved, not the print, and a falling ratio is not a cleaning contract; (3) ETH's 24h low still reads 2633.31 and its high24h 2722.14, so the 24h frame is unchanged while the 5m and 1h windows rolled hard. `market_context` REFUSED ON INDEPENDENCE a further check: ETH -2.443% sits between BTC -2.018% and SOL -2.236%, asserting only 'crypto is down', the identical observation that makes `trend` down. `derivatives` NOT CLAIMED - ZERO UNCLAMPED FUNDING RATES A SECOND CONSECUTIVE CHECK (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP all exactly +0.010000%, BNB exactly 0.000000%); next funding 2026-09-24 16:00Z = 00:00 local, so the 00:00 check sits on the settlement, not this one. RECORDED HONESTLY AND AGAINST THE SHORT: `volume` mildly favours the LONG this check, not the short - the 12:55Z breakout bar traded 347,466, the largest of the 48-bar window, against a 40-bar median of 130,958, with 12:25Z at 312,885. That is participation arriving on the upside, and it is one more reason the short's premise is gone; it is NOT claimed as a category for a long, because an unheld twenty-minute breakout is not evidence yet. `news` RECORDED, NOT CLAIMED, AND A REASON NOT TO TRADE: the Trump-Xi summit is in Washington today with an explicitly binary framing, and the 24-hour holding limit carries anything opened now straight through it.
